entities.name: First acid substrate
observations: Contains a carboxylic acid intended for amide coupling.

entities.name: Amide coupling
observations: The carboxylic acid and primary amine are coupled to form a carboxamide.
The other components are consistent with THF solvent, DIPEA base, and a benzotriazole uronium tetrafluoroborate coupling reagent.

entities.name: Predicted amide product
observations: The acid OH is replaced by NH-C(cyclopropyl)(4-trifluoromethylphenyl).
